toolsPreview.name: submit_urls
toolsPreview.description: Submit a list of URLs to be checked. Returns a job_id that can be polled via get_job_status or fetched via get_job_results. For up to ~200 URLs this tool waits for completion (up to 60 seconds) and returns the results directly; for larger jobs it returns early with job_id and the agent should poll.

toolsPreview.name: get_job_status
toolsPreview.description: Get the current status and progress of a job.

toolsPreview.name: get_job_results
toolsPreview.description: Fetch paginated results for a job. Each result has the URL, HTTP status code (null if unreachable), response time in ms, and an error message if the check failed.

toolsPreview.name: get_usage
toolsPreview.description: Return the current credit balance for this API key.
